personalInfo.name: Esdras Shaa Prombo
personalInfo.title: M.Sc. Data Science
personalInfo.bio: Data science focused on modelling, analysing and visualising numerical and text data for prediction and pattern recognition. Driven by devotion and perseverance.

projects.title: Master's Thesis
projects.description: Investigated how immigration discourse relates to economic conditions in Germany.

projects.title: ETL and Sentiment Analysis Framework
projects.description: An automated framework that extracts and processes Bundestag speeches to determine fiscal policy sentiment, turning raw parliamentary text into structured, analysable insights.

projects.title: Multivariate Analysis of Raman Spectra
projects.description: An unsupervised learning approach to classify tissue samples using Raman spectroscopy. Spectra from healthy and diseased animals are reduced with PCA and UMAP and clustered with k-Means to identify distinct cell types and detect differences between health states.

projects.title: Mini Machine Learning Library in C++
projects.description: A small object-oriented machine learning library written in modern C++. It includes a DataFrame for numeric data, CSV loading, scalers such as Min-Max and Standard, and several ML algorithms. It is built with CMake as a reusable static library and comes with unit tests and example programs.

projects.title: Inversion Effect in Neural Networks
projects.description: A research project testing whether the face inversion effect also appears in CNNs trained for object categorization. Pretrained AlexNet, VGG16 and ResNet were evaluated on 1,000 ImageNet images from 100 categories, shown upright and rotated by 180°. Features from the penultimate layer were classified with an SVM, and the inversion effect was scored per category. All three models showed a consistent but small inversion effect. Its overall size was similar across architectures, but the categories it affected most differed between models.

keyResponsibilities: Automatically downloaded all German Bundestag plenary protocols for each quarter.
Preprocessed the protocols using the provided preprocessing pipeline.
Calculated fiscal policy sentiment scores for individual speeches using DynamicDoc2Vec based on Latifi et al. (2024).
Aggregated speech-level sentiment scores into quarterly measures for total, government, and opposition speeches.
Built an automated workflow using Apache Airflow, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI for data processing and monitoring.
Applied unsupervised learning to Raman spectra as a new, data-driven alternative to conventional tissue sample classification.
Explored and preprocessed spectral imaging data (intensity vs. wavelength, spatial rasters), testing different normalisations and background corrections.
Reduced dimensionality with PCA and UMAP, and visualised principal components as colour-coded tissue images and distribution plots.
Clustered spectra with k-Means to identify distinct cell types, and validated cluster count and representative spectra against the tissue images.
Compared tissue samples from healthy and diseased animals to detect spectral differences between health states.

education.degree: Master of Science in Data Science
education.description: Ongoing master's program with 107 of at least 120 ECTS completed. Core modules include Advanced Data Analytics, High Performance Computing, Information Visualization, Artificial Intelligence I and II, Object-Oriented Programming for Data Science, Topological Data Analysis, and project modules in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Electives in Advanced Econometrics and Time Series Econometrics, plus a professional practice module.

education.degree: Certificates of Competency in LLMs and Deep Learning
education.description: Completed three NVIDIA certificate courses: Building RAG Agents with LLMs, Rapid Application Development with Large Language Models, and Fundamentals of Deep Learning. Gained hands-on experience building retrieval-augmented generation agents, developing LLM-powered applications, and training deep learning models.

Passed the German language exam for university admission (DSH) with the overall result DSH-2, which certifies the language ability required for unrestricted admission to all degree programs at German universities.

Studied German as a foreign language at the Goethe-Institut in Cameroon, building the language foundation for studying in Germany. This was followed by the DSH-2 certificate, which qualifies for unrestricted admission to German universities.

Completed a three-year fundamental computer science program (L1-L3) with an overall grade of B. Coursework covered algorithm design and analysis, data structures, databases, software engineering, web application engineering, data engineering, and object-oriented programming (including C++)
